defect: The new MarkBeginPrepare/MarkEndPrepare/MarkRollback/MarkCommit overrides lack the override keyword while the sibling methods have it, so clang's -Winconsistent-missing-override with -Werror breaks the build.
reason: The fix only adds override to exactly the four methods this change added, repairing a clang compile failure.

defect: In the new ComparatorWithU64TsImpl::CompareTimestamp the local ts_sz is used only inside asserts, so a release (NDEBUG) build fails with an unused-variable error under -Werror.
reason: The fix removes the assert-only local introduced by this change to repair the release build.

defect: AssignTimestamp/AssignTimestamps became member templates declared in the public header while their definitions live only in the internal db/write_batch_internal.h, so applications calling them get undefined-symbol link errors.
reason: The fix (issue 9272 link error) replaces exactly these template declarations with std::function parameters; seeing that the definitions are not reachable from the public header requires the other file.

defect: The new reseek in FindPrevUserEntry seeks to saved_key_ even when a deletion just cleared saved_key_, seeking to the start of the DB so Prev()/SeekToLast() can return the first key.
reason: The fix guards exactly this added reseek with a saved_key_cleared flag, and the clearing on deletion is visible in the same loop.

defect: Printing the uint64 flag FLAGS_db_write_buffer_size with %llu is wrong where uint64_t is unsigned long (Linux), causing a -Wformat error under -Werror.
reason: The change replaced %lu with a non-portable %llu and the same-day fix switches to PRIu64 to repair the resulting compile warning.

defect: DestroyColumnFamilyHandle(*handle) is called inside assert(), so in release builds the handle is never destroyed (leak) when import fails.
reason: The fix moves the call out of the assert that this change introduced.

defect: ContinueBackgroundWork() is called only inside assert(), so in release builds background work stays paused after a refit-level CompactRange, causing a hang.
reason: The fix moves the call out of the assert this change added, matching the reported hang on close with refit level.

defect: AddRangeTombstoneIterators is called only inside assert(), so in release builds immutable-memtable range tombstones are never added to the aggregator and are silently ignored.
reason: The fix moves both calls out of the asserts that this change introduced.

defect: Reset() zeroes new_table_block_iter_nanos twice and never resets the new new_table_iterator_nanos counter.
reason: The fix replaces the duplicated line added by this change with the missing counter.

defect: GetSliceForFileNumber takes file_number by value and returns a Slice pointing at its own parameter, a dangling pointer used as the cache key.
reason: The fix makes the helper take a pointer to the caller's variable, repairing the use-after-scope this change added.

defect: The test uses the non-standard type uint, which does not exist on MSVC, breaking the Windows (AppVeyor) build.
reason: The fix replaces exactly the uint declared by this change with uint32_t.

defect: The function-static counter stats_dump_threads_started is shared by all DB instances but read and incremented under each DB's own mutex, a data race.
reason: The fix makes the counter added by this change atomic with fetch_add.

defect: FbsonOutStream derives from std::ostream but never constructs the base with a streambuf pointer, relying on a non-standard default constructor that leaves the ios state uninitialized under libc++, so it segfaults on Mac OS X.
reason: The fix adds std::ostream(nullptr) to both constructors of the class this change (re)added, and the missing base initialization is visible in the new file.

defect: The new asserts in RecordTick compare the name-map sizes with ENUM_MAX - 1 although each map lists all ENUM_MAX entries, so every RecordTick fails its assert in debug builds.
reason: The same-day fix corrects exactly the two asserts added by this change, and the entry counts are visible in the diff.

defect: The new early return in Run() when db_ is null also skips DoCommand for commands that legitimately run without a DB (NoDBOpen), breaking them and reduce_levels_test.
reason: The fix removes exactly the added check; the NoDBOpen branch that leaves db_ null is in the same function.

defect: The new PopulateCommandArgs template compares int i with the size_t template parameter N, a sign-compare warning that breaks the -Werror (TSAN/clang) build.
reason: The fix casts N in exactly the loop this change added.

defect: MultiGetSimple writes keys[6] into a vector of size 6, an out-of-bounds write (undefined behaviour caught by valgrind) that also leaves keys[5] empty.
reason: The fix changes the index to 5 in the test lines added by this change.

defect: TestPropertiesCollector::AddUserKey and Finish override virtuals without the override keyword while Name/GetReadableProperties use it, breaking the clang -Werror build (inconsistent-missing-override).
reason: The fix adds override to exactly the two methods this change introduced.

defect: std::integral_constant<size_t, 64ull << 30> is instantiated even when std::conditional selects the 32-bit branch, and the value does not fit a 32-bit size_t, so 32-bit builds fail to compile.
reason: The fix changes the type of exactly this added integral_constant to uint64_t to repair the 32-bit build failure (#1110).

defect: CacheDependencies skips the bulk prefetch of all filter partitions whenever an enabled tail prefetch buffer is passed in, even if that buffer does not cover the partitions, causing one read per partition and much higher read I/O at DB open.
reason: The fix tightens exactly the condition this change added; seeing that the tail buffer can be too small needs the tail-size logic in the table reader.

defect: The new test refreshes a default-constructed MutableCFOptions whose per-level multiplier vector is empty (out-of-bounds read in RefreshDerivedOptions) and leaves smallest_seqno/largest_seqno uninitialized, which breaks the -Werror build.
reason: The same-day fix initializes mutable_cf_options_ from Options and zero-initializes the seqnos in the file this change added; the uninitialized locals are visible in the diff.

defect: ProcessManifestWrites and WriteCurrentStateToManifest assign the shared VersionSet::io_status_ while the DB mutex is released, racing with other threads that reset it via SetIOStatusOK under the mutex.
reason: The fix removes these unlocked io_status_ writes added by this change and updates io_status_ only after re-acquiring the mutex, though the TSAN failure it cites was made frequent by the later #6949.

defect: The fix adds sync points so that ColumnFamilyTest.FlushAndDropRaceCondition no longer hangs intermittently when the FlushJob::InstallResults sync point waits while holding the DB mutex.
reason: This change only added the missing comma that made the test's intended sync-point dependency take effect; the hang comes from the earlier test design and is fixed by a test-synchronization change.

defect: The int64_t timesec is printed with %ld, which mismatches where int64_t is long long (Mac), a -Wformat error under -Werror.
reason: The fix switches exactly this added format string to PRIi64.

defect: std::uniform_int_distribution<char> is not allowed by the standard (char is not a valid IntType) and fails to compile on MSVC.
reason: The fix replaces the two uniform_int_distribution<char> instances this change added with int.

defect: GetEstimatedActiveKeys scales the sampled counts by files_->size(), which is only the number of level-0 files because files_ is an array of per-level vectors, so the estimate is wrong.
reason: The fix replaces files_->size() in the lines this change added with the total file count over all levels, and files_ is shown in the diff as new std::vector<FileMetaData*>[num_levels_].

defect: static_cast<uint32> uses a type that is not defined outside Chromium, so the build fails on Linux.
reason: The same-day fix changes exactly this added cast to uint32_t.

defect: FSReadRequest read_req is default-initialized with only offset and len set and then copied into the vector, so its other members (scratch, result) are copied uninitialized and GCC 12 fails with -Werror=maybe-uninitialized.
reason: The fix value-initializes exactly the local that this change introduced.

defect: PackedMatches computes 1 << i with an int for i up to 63, undefined behaviour for i >= 31, so the packed results and the baked-in expected values are wrong.
reason: The fix changes the shift added by this change to uint64_t{1} << i and corrects the expected values.

defect: The new Log2 helper computes log(n) / log(2), which is imprecise for exact powers of two (ceil can round up a whole step) and broke the Travis build.
reason: The fix restores the library log2 in the helper this change added, keeping the log ratio only for Android.

defect: AsString now calls ToString(ConfigOptions) without the #ifndef ROCKSDB_LITE guard the old code had, and that overload does not exist in LITE builds, so the LITE build breaks.
reason: The same-day fix restores the LITE guard around exactly the lines this change rewrote.

defect: FilterPolicyNameStats assigns NewBloomFilterPolicy(10) to the raw, non-owning Options::filter_policy pointer and never deletes it, leaking memory (valgrind failure).
reason: The fix wraps exactly this added allocation in a unique_ptr; knowing that Options does not own filter_policy needs options.h.

defect: The debug delay arrays are plain static ints written by TEST_Set*Delay from the test thread and read by TEST_*Delay in background threads, a data race reported by TSAN.
reason: The fix makes the arrays this change added std::atomic; the cross-thread use is in the callers.

defect: The new MultiGet initializes every status to IOError, so keys the table reader never touches (for example excluded by the bloom filter) are returned as IOError instead of NotFound; it also passes no merge operator or merge context.
reason: The same-day fix initializes the statuses to OK and supplies a merge operator and context in the code this change added; that the reader leaves statuses untouched needs the table reader.

defect: Removing the #if defined(OS_MACOSX) guard makes the local ThreadData* tls_ in ~A() shadow the __thread static member tls_ on Linux, breaking the clang -Werror,-Wshadow build.
reason: The same-day fix restores a guard around exactly that local declaration, which this change had unguarded.

defect: Changing the Fold lambda to capture by reference makes it unconvertible to the plain function pointer that env_->StartThread takes, so the test no longer compiles with clang.
reason: The same-day fix reverts to a captureless lambda and makes the constants static.

defect: MaybeScheduleFlushOrCompaction sets bg_schedule_needed_ whenever a flush is pending and no flush slot is free, even when max_background_flushes is 0 and flushes run in compaction threads, so compactions get rescheduled endlessly.
reason: The fix restricts exactly this added assignment to max_background_flushes > 0, and the zero-flush-thread case is handled visibly a few lines below.

defect: GetDataBlockFromCache calls GetCreateCallback with *block->GetValue() although the block is asserted empty, binding a reference to a null pointer (undefined behaviour).
reason: The fix makes GetCreateCallback a template without the value argument, removing the null dereference this change added right after assert(block->IsEmpty()).

defect: Flipping the condition to sync the WAL only when avoid_flush_during_shutdown is true drops the sync for the default false case, where Close does not flush memtables with WAL enabled, so reopen in the stress test reports missing values.
reason: The fix makes the sync unconditional when the WAL is on, restoring the case this change removed; knowing that Close does not flush in that case needs db_impl.

defect: The __clang_analyzer__ branch constructs ParsedInternalKey(Slice(), 0, 0), but the int 0 does not convert to ValueType, so clang-analyzer builds fail to compile.
reason: The fix removes exactly this added branch; the constructor signature is in db/dbformat.h.
